councillors.name: skeptic
councillors.prompt: Examine failure modes, edge cases, and risks. Challenge the happiest-path assumptions. Supporting the proposal is fine when the evidence supports it.

councillors.name: architect
councillors.prompt: Examine maintainability, boundaries, feasibility, migration path, and long-term cost.

councillors.name: minimalist
councillors.prompt: Compare against the smallest designs that still meet the requirement. Ask what each piece of complexity earns.
